login.title: Enter the test screen
login.description: Type the password your supervisor gave you.
login.notSet: The administrator has not set the password yet. Please ask them.

identify.title: Who are you?
identify.description: Choose your name from the list. If it is not there, choose “Other” and type it.
identify.other: Other (my name is not in the list)
identify.newNameHint: You will be added to the list as a candidate. An administrator can check the name later.

home.noMaterial: No study material has been uploaded yet.
home.pdfHelp: If the PDF does not appear in this page (some phones only show the first page), use “Open in a new tab”.
home.testInfo: {count} questions are chosen at random. You need {required} correct answers to pass.
home.notReady: This test is not available yet. Please ask an administrator.
home.allDoneTitle: You have completed every certification step.
home.allDoneBody: You can still read the study material below whenever you need it.

test.autosaveFailed: Could not save your answers just now. They are kept in this page; check your connection.
test.confirmUnanswered: Unanswered questions count as incorrect. Not answered yet: {list}
test.leave: Back to start (your progress is kept)

result.title: Result
result.required: {required} correct answers were needed to pass.
result.failedHint: Read the questions below and the study material, then try again.
result.onlyIncorrect: Show only questions I got wrong

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do that.
errors.crossSite: The request was blocked for security reasons. Reload the page and try again.
errors.materialNotFound: No study material has been uploaded for this test.
errors.bankNotFound: There is no question bank for this test yet.
errors.attemptNotFound: That test attempt was not found.
errors.invalidInput: Some of the entered data is not valid ({field}).
errors.badJson: The data could not be read.
errors.invalidName: A name must be 1 to {max} characters long and must not contain control characters.
errors.memberNameExists: This name is already in the list. Please choose it from the list.
errors.tooManyNames: Too many names at once (at most {max}).
errors.passwordNotSet: The password has not been set yet.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many wrong attempts. Please wait {retryAfterSec} seconds and try again.
errors.invalidPassword: The password must be {min} to {max} characters long.
errors.passwordManagedByEnv: This password is set by an environment variable and cannot be changed here.
errors.wrongCurrentPassword: The current password is not correct.
errors.notPdf: This file is not a PDF.
errors.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than {maxMb} MB.
errors.unsupportedContentType: The request has an unsupported format.
errors.wrongRole: This test is not for your current role.
errors.testNotReady: This test is not available yet.
errors.attemptClosed: This test has already been handed in.
errors.attemptNotFinished: This test attempt is not finished yet.
errors.invalidAnswers: The answers could not be read. Reload the page.
errors.reviewNotConfirmed: Please confirm that a person has checked the questions.
errors.bankInvalid: The question bank has problems. See the list below.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again.
errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.

json.syntax: The text is not valid JSON ({message}).

root.invalid: The JSON must be an object with a “questions” list.
root.array: The file is a plain list of questions (no “meta” information).

schema.unsupported: This file format version ({version}) is not supported.

input.fenceStripped: The Markdown code fence around the JSON was removed.
input.extraTextIgnored: Text before or after the JSON was ignored. Check that nothing important was cut off.

question.notObject: This entry is not a question object.
question.textTooLong: The question text is longer than {max} characters.
question.textShort: The question text is very short.
question.choicesMissing: The list of choices is missing.
question.choiceEmpty: Choice {choice} is empty or not text.
question.refersToChoices: The question refers to other choices by letter; choices are shuffled, so this will be confusing.
question.noteInvalid: “{field}” must be text of at most {max} characters.

choice.allOfTheAbove: Choice {choice} looks like “all of the above”, which does not work when choices are shuffled.
choice.refersToOthers: Choice {choice} refers to other choices by letter; choices are shuffled, so this will be confusing.

answer.isNumber: The answer is the number {value}. Use the letter of the correct choice (A, B, C, …); numbers are not accepted because counting from 0 or 1 is ambiguous.
answer.invalid: The answer “{value}” is not a letter such as A, B, C.
answer.outOfRange: The answer {letter} does not exist: the question has only {count} choices.

bank.tooFew: There are {count} questions, but at least {required} are needed to draw one test.
bank.sizeDiffers: There are {count} questions; {expected} are expected. The test still works.
bank.duplicateId: The id “{id}” is used by several questions ({questions}).
bank.answerSkew: {percent}% of the correct answers are “{letter}”. AIs often favour one letter; choices are shuffled during the test, but check the answers again.

issues.omitted: …and {count} more problems of the same kind ({of}).

login.title: Administrator login
login.hint: When the app starts for the first time, the administrator password is shown once in the terminal window.

dashboard.title: Progress
dashboard.selfRegistered_one: {count} person typed their own name. Please check that the name is correct.
dashboard.selfRegistered_other: {count} people typed their own names. Please check that the names are correct.
dashboard.noMembers: There are no members yet. Add them in the “Members” section.
dashboard.noRecent: Nobody has taken a test yet.

members.title: Members
members.name: Name
members.bulkHelp: One name per line. Names that already exist are skipped.
members.selfRegisteredHelp: This person typed their own name. Saving any change (even without editing) marks it as checked.
members.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? All of their test results are deleted too. This cannot be undone.
members.roleHelp: People move up automatically when they pass a test. You can also change a role by hand here.

tests.title: Tests and questions
tests.intro: For each test: upload the study PDF, ask an AI to draft questions from it, import and check them, then review them yourself.

material.title: Study material (PDF)
material.help: People see this PDF first, before they take the test.
material.none: No PDF has been uploaded yet.

prompt.title: 1. Ask an AI to draft the questions
prompt.help: Attach the study PDF to a chat with an AI (for example ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini), paste the prompt below, and save the JSON the AI returns. This app never contacts an AI itself.
prompt.warning: An AI can make mistakes: it may invent facts or mark a wrong answer as correct. A person must check every question against the PDF before the test is used.
prompt.info: The prompt asks for {count} questions with {choices} choices each.
prompt.textLabel: Prompt to paste into the AI chat
prompt.copyFailed: Copying failed. Select the text and copy it by hand.

bank.importHelp: Upload the JSON file or paste its text. It is checked first; nothing is saved until you confirm.
bank.resultErrors: {count} problems must be fixed before the file can be used
bank.resultWarnings: {count} things to look at (the file can still be used)
bank.reviewConfirm: A person has checked every question and its correct answer against the study material.
bank.replaceWarning: This replaces the current question bank ({count} questions). Results of tests that were already taken are not affected.
bank.none: There is no question bank yet.
bank.notEnough: At least {required} questions are needed for one test.
bank.source: Source (page or section of the PDF)

settings.title: Settings
settings.mismatch: The two new passwords are not the same.
settings.changed: The password was changed. Other administrator logins were ended.
settings.managedByEnv: This password is set by an environment variable (ADMIN_PASSWORD) and cannot be changed here.
settings.participantHelp: Everyone who takes the tests types this password to enter the test screen. Share it with your team.
settings.participantNotSet: No participant password is set yet. Nobody can log in to the test screen until you set one.
settings.participantSet: A participant password is set. It cannot be shown again; set a new one if it was forgotten.
settings.participantManagedByEnv: The participant password is set by an environment variable (PARTICIPANT_PASSWORD) and cannot be changed here.
settings.setOwn: Set a password of my choice
settings.shownOnce: The new participant password (shown only now):
settings.logsOut: Changing the participant password logs out everybody who is currently logged in on the test screen.
settings.dataBody: Names, roles, test results, questions and study PDFs are stored on the computer or server that runs this app (in its data folder). Nothing is sent anywhere else.
